import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long a = 0, b = 1; // 0/1=0 initial fraction
    static long x, y, n;

    static void compare(long dn, long i) {
        long s1 = Math.abs((b * y) * ((x * i) - (y * dn)));
        long s2 = Math.abs((y * i) * ((b * x) - (a * y)));
        if (s1 < s2 || (s1 == s2 && i < b)) {
            b = i;
            a = dn;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long d1 = i * x / y;
            long d2 = d1 + 1;
            compare(d1, i);
            compare(d2, i);
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
